steps.en: Open the platform app and choose local speech and chat models
steps.zh: 打开对应平台应用，选择本地语音和聊天模型

steps.en: Downloads models and starts listening after microphone permission
steps.zh: 获得麦克风权限后下载模型并开始聆听
在讨论中叫 Jarvis 的名字并提问

steps.en: Uses recent spoken context to answer aloud
steps.zh: 结合近期口头语境并朗读回答

value.en: The assistant can answer about the discussion you just had
value.zh: 助手能回应你们刚刚讨论的内容
